titolo: ChatGPT Enterprise launches on AWS Marketplace
descr: OpenAI adds ChatGPT Enterprise to AWS Marketplace, letting firms buy via existing AWS contracts.
paragrafi: OpenAI announced that ChatGPT Enterprise is now listed on AWS Marketplace.
The new listing allows organizations to procure the service through their current AWS purchasing and billing relationships.
ChatGPT Enterprise offers the same capabilities as the standalone offering, aimed at business users who need higher security and compliance.
The move aligns with AWS’s strategy to expand its AI portfolio and simplify cloud‑based software acquisition for enterprise customers.
perche: Businesses can now integrate ChatGPT Enterprise into their existing AWS spend, reducing procurement friction. Users of free or locally hosted models still have alternatives, but enterprise customers gain a streamlined path to a managed, high‑performance AI service.
